aboutHeading: Serving south central Indiana for over 35 years
aboutParagraphs: Harris Heating & Air Conditioning is a locally owned Bloomington company that has kept Monroe County homes and businesses comfortable for more than three decades.

We specialize in Tempstar heating and cooling systems and ClimateMaster geothermal equipment, including 95% efficient furnaces, central air conditioning and geothermal heat pumps. We also service and repair all makes and models, so you can call us no matter what's in your basement.
brandsNote: Repairs on all makes and models of heating and cooling equipment.

faq.a: Yes. Estimates on the installation of new heating and cooling equipment are free. Call us to set up a visit.

Geothermal systems use the stable temperature underground to heat and cool your home, which makes them among the most efficient systems available. They cost more up front than a conventional furnace and AC, so we'll help you compare long-term savings for your home and property.
